scientific_integrity: Arbitrary-size statements follow from the row Gram matrix and finite-dimensional fixed-algebra proof; finite matrix tests are consistency checks rather than independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the specified finite periodic single-particle rhombic chain, strictly positive pure-site dephasing at each backbone site and no dephasing on bridges.
Finite-time robustness near half flux, interactions, disorder, and baths or coupling to leads are not covered.
An inaccessible full text on noisy discrete-time Aharonov-Bohm cages leaves residual bibliographic uncertainty.
title: Half-flux fragmentation in a selectively dephased diamond chain
